name: MeasurementUnits
src_typeComment: Shared unit conversion for the Level Transform Guidance hub — used by the Measuring Tape tab (to label distances) AND the Heatmap tab (to let you express cell size in a unit you actually think in, so the grid doubles as a measurable guideline). Exactly the kind of small shared plumbing the hub exists to make possible rather than each tool re-deriving it.  Unity world units are conventionally treated as METERS throughout the engine (physics especially), so "meters" is the base both directions convert through.

src_members.sig: public static float FromMeters(float meters, MeasurementUnit unit)
src_members.name: FromMeters

src_members.sig: public static float ToMeters(float value, MeasurementUnit unit)
src_members.name: ToMeters

src_members.sig: public static string Format(float meters, MeasurementUnit unit) => $"{FromMeters(meters, unit):F2} {Suffix(unit)}"
src_members.name: Format
